headline: Fronts Erupt as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the map has sharpened across a half‑dozen sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest flashpoint, logging 39 ownership changes in the past 24 hours and a fresh surge of 10 701 Colonial and 11 394 Warden casualties, with both sides’ enlistments still climbing. Mooring County matches that tempo, also recording 37 flips and a 24‑hour toll of 10 897 Colonial and 10 049 Warden dead while fresh troops pour in. Stonecradle continues to bleed, adding 17 flips centred on World’s End, The Reach and Buckler Sound, pushing its totals to 61 627 Colonial and 78 750 Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf registers 11 flips around Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, now at 59 608 Colonial and 66 815 Warden losses. Palantine Berm erupts with six new flips in the last six hours, the first notable activity there this war, driving its toll to 2 677 Colonial and 3 337 Warden. Linn Mercy shows a steady three‑hour rhythm of three captures and three neutralisations, raising its count to 54 836 Colonial and 69 211 Warden. Northern Warden‑held rear areas and most Colonial‑only regions remain quiet, with no ownership changes reported.
